items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I remember once we made a tour with Big Joe Turner. He was on tour with us.

ctx.x: Yes, yes. That was really fun playing with Humphrey because it was like a challenge because we were always trying to, trying to do something different than the next one and trying to do it better than the next, you know. It was really fun. And seeing all of the English, the countryside.
We went all over England and sometimes we had, I remember once we made a tour with Big Joe Turner. He was on tour with us. Newcastle, that's

have you heard of Newcastle brown ale? (LAUGHTER). I tried to drink some of that, that brown ale, but it made me sick. They said that that's what the sailors take when they're going out on, I don't know why they it. They must have found something better than that. It was too strong for me.
